review_scope: AI-assisted contextual inventory of every numbered table and figure in both supplied PDFs. Every numbered display has a full-display generator in paper/build/displays (implementation[0]) that `make paper` runs on the published outputs; record_sets lists the measurement-record sets each generator reads. The registered constants hold the declared S15 accounting ranges, the S19 descriptions, the S28b sigma grid and the declared analytical input coordinates of Tables S28/S28b and Figure S17g (supplementary pages 18-19 and 36), distinct from observed support minima and unrounded measured effects. Main Figure 5a (page 12) and supplementary Figure S4 (page 32) use the declared cost-range endpoints, with the three S4 methods not tabulated in S15/S15b. Figure S17d keeps its labelled independence illustration separate from the paired S16/S16b intervals. Independent comparison targets, including the reference definitions of supplementary Figures S1, S5, S8, S10 and S19 and Table S29, are in printed_display_values.json; formula-derived coordinates carry their source inputs and precision.
